data.text:
Vishal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 July, 2024 
Author: Prem Narayan Singh
Bench: Prem Narayan Singh
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Prem Narayan Singh
 On The 12th Of July, 2024
 Criminal Appeal No. 9305 of 2019
 Vishal And Others
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 None Present.
 Shri Gaurav Rawat, Learned G.A. For State.
 Order 
T h i s appeal has been filed under Section 71(6) of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 on behalf of the appellant being aggrieved by the judgment dated 28.8.2019. 
Today, none for the appellant. 
Earlier also none appeared on behalf of the appellant on two consecutive dates i.e. on 29.05.2024 and 19.02.2024. 
The appeal is pending since, 2019. I t seems that the appellant has lost his interest in prosecuting the present appeal, hence, the same is dismissed for want of prosecution. 
(PREM NARAYAN SINGH ) JUDGE VD Vishal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25867575/
